responsibility: This grammar/action source defines mc parser pass 3, which resolves most declaration-level semantics beyond basic type identity. Its actions build arrays, pointers, sets, records, procedure types and formal parameters, process imports and exports, attach constants and variable declarations, and use an explicit construction stack plus meta-diagnostics to populate the declaration AST with full type and scope information before constant-expression folding and code-body parsing.
same_name_distinction: This .bnf file is the grammar/action source for parser pass 3 in the mcp3 stem, including productions and semantic code that uses mcStack and decl helpers to build composite types, parameters, imports, and constant-expression state; mcp3.def only declares CompilationUnit for invoking that generated parser.
